# ChartBook

> A developer platform for data science teams to discover, document, and share analytics work. Provides a centralized catalog for pipelines, charts, and dataframes with automatic documentation website generation.

ChartBook organizes analytics work into **pipelines** (self-contained projects) or **catalogs** (multi-pipeline collections). All configuration uses TOML format (`chartbook.toml`).

## Installation

```bash
# For data loading
pip install chartbook

# For CLI (recommended: isolated installation)
pipx install chartbook
```

## Python API

```python
from chartbook import data

# Load dataframe (requires configured catalog or explicit path)
df = data.load(pipeline="MARKETS", dataframe="market_data")

# Load as polars DataFrame
df = data.load(pipeline="MARKETS", dataframe="market_data", format="polars")

# Load as polars LazyFrame
lf = data.load(pipeline="MARKETS", dataframe="market_data", format="polars-lazyframe")

# Explicit catalog path (no global config needed)
df = data.load(pipeline="MARKETS", dataframe="market_data",
               catalog_path="/path/to/catalog")

# Get resolved data file path
path = data.get_data_path(pipeline="MARKETS", dataframe="market_data")

# Get documentation content as string
docs = data.get_docs(pipeline="MARKETS", dataframe="market_data")

# Get path to documentation source file
docs_path = data.get_docs_path(pipeline="MARKETS", dataframe="market_data")
```

## CLI Commands

```bash
chartbook build              # Generate HTML documentation
chartbook build -f           # Force overwrite existing docs
chartbook build --keep-build-dirs  # Keep temp files for debugging
chartbook publish            # Publish to directory
chartbook create-data-glimpses     # Create data summary report
chartbook config             # Configure default catalog path
```

## Global Configuration

User settings stored in `~/.chartbook/settings.toml`:

```toml
[catalog]
path = "/absolute/path/to/catalog/chartbook.toml"
```

Set via `chartbook config` command. When configured, `data.load()` works without explicit `catalog_path`.

## Project Types

### Pipeline Project
```toml
[config]
type = "pipeline"
chartbook_format_version = "0.0.12"
```

### Catalog Project (aggregates multiple pipelines)
```toml
[config]
type = "catalog"
chartbook_format_version = "0.0.12"

[pipelines.SALES]
path_to_pipeline = "../pipelines/sales"

[pipelines.DATA.MONTHLY]
Unix = "/data/pipelines/monthly"
Windows = "T:/pipelines/monthly"
```

## Configuration Reference

### [site] - Website Metadata
```toml
[site]
title = "My Analytics"
author = "Your Name"
copyright = "2025"
logo_path = "./assets/logo.png"      # Optional
favicon_path = "./assets/icon.png"   # Optional
```

### [pipeline] - Pipeline Information
```toml
[pipeline]
id = "MYPROJ"                        # Unique ID (uppercase)
pipeline_name = "My Pipeline"
pipeline_description = "Description"
lead_pipeline_developer = "Your Name"
contributors = ["Name1", "Name2"]    # Optional
git_repo_URL = "https://..."         # Optional
README_file_path = "./README.md"     # Optional
```

### [charts.chart_id] - Chart Definitions
```toml
[charts.revenue_trend]
chart_name = "Revenue Trend"
short_description_chart = "Monthly revenue trends"
dataframe_id = "revenue_data"
path_to_html_chart = "./_output/revenue_trend.html"
chart_docs_path = "./docs_src/charts/revenue_trend.md"
topic_tags = ["Revenue", "Monthly"]           # Optional
data_frequency = "Monthly"                    # Optional
units = "USD Millions"                        # Optional
date_cleared_by_iv_and_v = "2025-01-15"       # Optional: governance
last_legal_clearance_date = "2025-01-15"      # Optional: governance
```

### [dataframes.df_id] - Dataframe Definitions
```toml
[dataframes.market_data]
dataframe_name = "Market Data"
short_description_df = "Daily stock prices"
data_sources = ["Bloomberg", "Reuters"]
path_to_parquet_data = "./_data/market_data.parquet"
date_col = "date"
dataframe_docs_path = "./docs_src/dataframes/market_data.md"  # Optional
topic_tags = ["Market Data", "Equities"]                       # Optional
data_providers = ["Bloomberg LP", "Refinitiv"]                 # Optional
type_of_data_access = ["Subscription", "Subscription"]         # Optional
data_license = "Bloomberg Data License"                        # Optional
license_expiration_date = "2025-12-31"                         # Optional
```

### [notes] - Additional Documentation
```toml
[notes.methodology]
path_to_markdown_file = "./docs_src/methodology.md"
```

### [notebooks] - Jupyter Notebooks
```toml
[notebooks.analysis]
notebook_name = "Exploratory Analysis"
notebook_description = "Initial data exploration"
notebook_path = "_output/analysis.ipynb"
```

## Directory Structure

```
my-pipeline/
├── chartbook.toml      # Configuration
├── _data/              # Parquet data files
├── _output/            # Generated HTML charts
├── docs_src/           # Markdown documentation
│   ├── charts/
│   └── dataframes/
└── src/                # Python source code
```
